purpose: Reach people who already build and test Phaser games, ask for useful first-minute feedback and lead them directly to the live game without using weak media.

community.name: Phaser Showcase
community.currentFit: The official Showcase welcomes finished and work-in-progress Phaser creations, asks WIP topics to use the WIP label and asks creators to link to the game.
community.recentActivityMeaning: Recent Showcase topics were visible in 2026. This proves the forum is active, not that Mythical Void will receive views, replies or players.

sequence.reason: One route at a time makes the learning understandable and avoids repeating the same promotion across communities.

preparedTopic.title: [WIP] Mythical Void — a father-and-son creature adventure made with Phaser
preparedTopic.body:
Hi, I’m Kevin. My son and I started Mythical Void at home to see what imagination and today’s AI tools could help us make together. It has grown into a free browser game built with Phaser 3.

Play it here:
https://mythicalvoid.com/play/

You crash beyond mapped space, hatch an alien creature, explore six strange worlds and free Guardians trapped by the Void. What you do helps decide what Project Beacon tells Earth. It starts straight away, with no download or account.

If you try it, I would love two honest answers:
1. Was the first minute clear without an explanation?
2. Did movement and the controls make sense on the device you used?

This link opens the real running game. Generative AI is one of the tools we use to explore and build, but people make the story, safety and release decisions. Some optional space-discovery moments use credited public NASA material; NASA does not endorse Mythical Void.

I am not attaching our current screenshots or videos because I do not think they show the game well enough yet. I will read and answer replies myself. Thank you for trying it.
claims: no download or account required to start
generative AI is one tool in a human-led creative process
NASA does not endorse Mythical Void
feedbackQuestions: Was the first minute clear without an explanation?
Did movement and the controls make sense on the device you used?

public topic view and reply totals when shown

anonymous adult feedback total for the website, forum, newsletter or creator route
aftercare.privacy: Do not copy usernames, reply text, direct messages, device details or personal information into company records. Summarise repeated adult feedback without identifying anyone.

stopRules: Do not publish before the first r/WebGames read is complete or that route is explicitly cancelled.
Do not create a Phaser forum account or accept its terms for Kevin.
Do not attach the withdrawn screenshot or video pack.
Do not ask for likes, manufacture replies or post automated answers.
Do not turn criticism into an argument; thank the person and record repeated adult findings anonymously.
Do not contact children or move a public reply into a private conversation that appears to involve a child.
nextRequiredAction: Finish or explicitly cancel the first r/WebGames read, then Kevin confirms an existing adult Phaser forum account, accepts any current terms himself, approves this exact topic at action time and remains available to answer replies.
